normal_form.storage_model: flat payoff matrix and strategy arrays
normal_form.certification_goal: normal-form games execute from cache-local flat ECS data without recursive graph allocation

extensive_form.storage_model: Graph-ECS edge entities linked by EntityId through ChildOf and TransitionTo
extensive_form.certification_goal: sequential games traverse Graph-ECS component stores without self-referencing pointers or boxed topology nodes

solver_assertions.assertion: defect is the unique best response to cooperate and defect for each player
defect/defect is the unique pure Nash equilibrium

evidence_commands: rustup run stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu cargo test -p kairo-ecs-game-theory --test normal_form

solver_assertions.assertion: strictly dominated strategies are reported deterministically by player and strategy index

evidence_commands: rustup run stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu cargo test -p kairo-ecs-game-theory --test normal_form

solver_assertions.assertion: all terminal paths are enumerated through edge entities and EntityId targets
the current player at each decision node selects the branch with the highest own terminal utility

evidence_commands: rustup run stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu cargo test -p kairo-ecs-game-theory traversal_ --features graph-relations
rustup run stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu cargo test -p kairo-ecs-game-theory backward_induction --features graph-relations

solver_assertions.assertion: information-set grouped decision nodes belong to the same player and expose the same ordered action labels

evidence_commands: rustup run stable-x86_64-pc-windows-gnu cargo test -p kairo-ecs-game-theory information_set_fixtures --features graph-relations

acceptance_gates: normal-form and extensive-form scenarios are both present
each scenario records ECS components, solver assertions, and executable evidence commands
extensive-form scenarios use ChildOf and TransitionTo EntityId relations
no scenario requires self-referencing pointers, Box topology nodes, or recursive owned graph structures
known_limits: chance-weighted expected utility remains a bounded follow-up before stochastic extensive-form parity is claimed
this certification manifest records local runtime evidence and does not claim live HPC or distributed execution proof
